title: Concept: Legacy digest via MD5.hash (haskell) — review required
description: In haskell, MD5.hash computes MD5 or SHA-1, whose collision resistance is broken for signature and identity checks. Checksums against accidental corruption remain acceptable; security uses need SHA256.hash.
applicability: haskell codebases hashing with MD5.hash; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW severity.
